faqs.question: What's the dress code?
faqs.answer: We're requesting cocktail attire for our celebration. Think elegant but comfortable — suits, dress shirts, cocktail dresses, or dressy separates. Skip the jeans and flip-flops, but no need for a tuxedo or ballgown!

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqs.answer: We've done our best to accommodate everyone. Please check your invitation for the names of those invited. If your invitation says 'and guest,' you're welcome to bring a plus one!

faqs.question: Are kids welcome?
faqs.answer: While we love your little ones, we've decided to make our wedding an adults-only celebration. We hope this gives you a chance to enjoy a night out!

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: The ceremony begins at 4:30 PM. We recommend arriving 15-20 minutes early to find parking and get settled. The cocktail hour will begin immediately after the ceremony.

faqs.question: Is there parking?
faqs.answer: Parking information will be provided closer to the wedding date. We recommend using rideshare services like Uber or Lyft if you plan on enjoying the open bar. Your safety is important to us!

faqs.question: Where should I stay?
faqs.answer: Check out our Travel page for hotel recommendations near the venue. We'll be setting up room blocks with special rates — details coming soon!

faqs.question: Will there be food options for dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes! We'll be offering vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. If you have specific allergies or dietary needs, please let us know when you RSVP and we'll make sure you're taken care of.

faqs.question: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
faqs.answer: We kindly ask that you keep phones and cameras put away during the ceremony so everyone can be fully present. Our photographer will capture every moment! Feel free to snap away during the reception.

faqs.question: What's the weather like in September?
faqs.answer: September in Chicago is typically pleasant with temperatures between 55°F and 75°F. However, Chicago weather can be unpredictable! We recommend bringing a light layer for the evening.

faqs.question: Who do I contact with questions?
faqs.answer: For any questions, please reach out to us directly. You can email us at wedding@example.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible!
